riskFactors.title: Interest Coverage Below Threshold
riskFactors.description: Interest coverage ratio of 1.66x is below the 2.0x threshold, indicating limited cushion for interest expense increases.

mitigatingFactors.factor: Stable rental income from long-term leases

aggravatingFactors.factor: Limited ability to absorb rate increases

riskFactors.title: Concentrated Lease Expiry in 2025
riskFactors.description: 48.5% of rental income expires in 2025, creating significant lease renewal risk.

riskFactors.title: Tenant Concentration Risk - Parkson
riskFactors.description: Parkson contributes approximately 12% of rental income, creating tenant concentration risk.

mitigatingFactors.factor: Parkson has multiple stores across portfolio

aggravatingFactors.factor: Retail sector headwinds affecting department stores

riskFactors.title: Secondary Market Concentration
riskFactors.description: Portfolio concentrated in secondary markets (Muar, Sungai Petani, Kulim, Segamat) with lower economic resilience than Klang Valley.

mitigatingFactors.factor: Wetex Parade 96.5% occupancy - strong local performance
Kolej Yayasan Saad stable educational income

aggravatingFactors.factor: Lower population density and spending power

riskFactors.title: Segamat Central Underperformance
riskFactors.description: Segamat Central operates at 58.4% occupancy, significantly below portfolio average of 84.0%.

mitigatingFactors.factor: Property contributes proportionally less to revenue

aggravatingFactors.factor: Segamat secondary market with limited catchment

riskFactors.title: Gearing at Upper Limit
riskFactors.description: Gearing ratio of 41.72% approaches the 50% regulatory limit, limiting debt capacity for acquisitions.

aggravatingFactors.factor: Valuation decline could trigger limit breach

keyDifferences: Secondary market concentration vs Klang Valley focus

observations.title: FY2024 Performance - DPU Decline
observations.content: Hektar REIT reported FY2024 DPU of 3.15 sen, down from 5.00 sen in FY2023. Performance impacted by higher finance costs, lower rental income from Segamat Central, and challenging retail environment.
observations.summary: DPU declined to 3.15 sen, occupancy at 84.0%

observations.title: Interest Coverage Below Safe Threshold
observations.content: Interest coverage ratio of 1.66x is below the 2.0x threshold considered safe for REITs. This indicates limited capacity to absorb further interest rate increases.

observations.title: Kolej Yayasan Saad Acquisition
observations.content: Successfully acquired Kolej Yayasan Saad in Melaka in July 2024. The property contributes 100% occupancy and stable educational rental income, diversifying the portfolio.
observations.summary: New acquisition at 100% occupancy in FY2024

observations.title: 2025 Lease Renewal Concentration
observations.content: 48.5% of rental income expires in 2025, presenting significant lease rollover risk. Management focus required on tenant retention and new leasing activity.
